summary: This clinical trial compares two different ways to monitor blood sugar in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus who are taking the medication dapagliflozin. One group uses continuous glucose monitoring, which tracks sugar levels automatically, while the other group uses traditional self-monitoring with blood sugar meters. The study has a status of Not yet recruiting and aims to enroll 120 participants.

facts.sponsor: The Third Xiangya Hospital of Central South University
